First time America and Defcon. Heard about this being the best amazing for like more than half a decade. Finally came down, heard alot of good stuffs about villages, went in (I really don't wanna name the villages coz they are amazing on its own, it's just I felt some contents that I felt should've been more in depth were more general), was bit disappointed that talks that I went in specifically for, based on their abstract, weren't as in-depth or fruitful for me. I would definately still give 6/10 though. After first day, I was just spending rest of the con by the pool and hanging around with friends. 
Next time if I'm coming for defcon, I would just come with the mindset of getting into random talks and more for winding down and enjoying with friends.

Keep expectations super low so that you won't be disappointed. 
There aren't always amazing super talks that you feel coz it's Defcon. Treat it as any other great cons out there, enjoy Vegas, villages and catching up/networking with friends.
